#HP7DM: The `eval` method in `LocateEvaluator` contains nested try-with-resources statements which can be simplified for better readability. Consider using a single try-with-resources statement with multiple resources if they are independent.
```java
try (BytesRefBlock strBlock = (BytesRefBlock) str.eval(page);
     BytesRefBlock substrBlock = (BytesRefBlock) substr.eval(page);
     IntBlock startBlock = (IntBlock) start.eval(page)) {
    // method body
}
```

#HP7DM: The `eval` methods for both `BytesRefBlock` and `BytesRefVector` have similar logic that could be abstracted into a helper method to reduce code duplication.
```java
private IntBlock eval(int positionCount, Block strBlock, Block substrBlock, Block startBlock) {
    try (IntBlock.Builder result = driverContext.blockFactory().newIntBlockBuilder(positionCount)) {
        BytesRef strScratch = new BytesRef();
        BytesRef substrScratch = new BytesRef();
        for (int p = 0; p < positionCount; p++) {
            if (strBlock.isNull(p) || strBlock.getValueCount(p) != 1 ||
                substrBlock.isNull(p) || substrBlock.getValueCount(p) != 1 ||
                startBlock.isNull(p) || startBlock.getValueCount(p) != 1) {
                handleMultiValueOrNull(result, p);
                continue;
            }
            result.appendInt(Locate.process(getBytesRef(strBlock, strScratch, p), getBytesRef(substrBlock, substrScratch, p), getInt(startBlock, p)));
        }
        return result.build();
    }
}
private void handleMultiValueOrNull(IntBlock.Builder result, int position) {
    if (strBlock.getValueCount(position) > 1 || substrBlock.getValueCount(position) > 1 || startBlock.getValueCount(position) > 1) {
        warnings.registerException(new IllegalArgumentException("single-value function encountered multi-value"));
    }
    result.appendNull();
}
private BytesRef getBytesRef(Block block, BytesRef scratch, int position) {
    return block instanceof BytesRefVector ? ((BytesRefVector) block).getBytesRef(position, scratch)
                                          : ((BytesRefBlock) block).getBytesRef(block.getFirstValueIndex(position), scratch);
}
private int getInt(Block block, int position) {
    return block instanceof IntVector ? ((IntVector) block).getInt(position)
                                     : ((IntBlock) block).getInt(block.getFirstValueIndex(position));
}
```

#H8WPY: The `process` method in the `Locate` class converts `BytesRef` to `String` using `utf8ToString()`, which can be inefficient for large strings. Consider using a more efficient string search algorithm that works directly on `BytesRef`.
